snippet.title: Can you finish speedrun under 8 min? Why Me?
snippet.description:
Our new platformer game “Why Me?” is now live on PlayStation 5 and Steam.
It even has a speedrun mode — and we still couldn’t finish it under 8 minutes. 😅

We’d love to hear how far you get and what you think.

🎮 PS5: https://lnkd.in/d4YBAHXQ

🖥️ Steam: https://lnkd.in/dXHYFUgk
#playstation5 #indiegame #steamgame #speedrun #challenge
